# @sectile/form API

Reference the public import paths exposed by @sectile/form.

Start with the [@sectile/form guide](/packages/form) for usage and examples. This page is the lookup reference for exact public import paths.

## Install

```sh
pnpm add @sectile/form
```

## Public import paths

| Import | Related reference |
| --- | --- |
| `@sectile/form` | Public package entry point |
| `@sectile/form/error` | Public package entry point |
| `@sectile/form/path` | Public package entry point |
| `@sectile/form/values` | Public package entry point |
| `@sectile/form/state` | Public package entry point |
| `@sectile/form/schema` | Public package entry point |

`package.json` is also exported for tooling.
